en.title: Informed consent for the Lites design-partner pilot
en.purpose: Evaluate whether Lites helps people transfer existing capabilities into a technology or AI career direction through Goal, Map, Learn, Practice, Create and Evidence.
en.procedures: Use an isolated pilot account for 28 days, complete the frozen onboarding, route, daily-loop and bounded-project tasks, and optionally provide structured feedback.
en.data: We collect pseudonymous event names and times, predefined task outcomes, locale and transition stratum, rubric scores, consent and withdrawal events, and technical reliability events. We do not collect conversation bodies, reflection bodies, BYOK values, passwords, raw tokens or unrelated employer data for pilot metrics.
en.risks: Possible inconvenience, frustration, incorrect AI suggestions, or accidental entry of personal information. Lites does not make hiring, promotion, termination or ranking decisions.
en.benefits: You may receive a structured capability-transfer route, but personal benefit is not guaranteed.
en.voluntary: Participation is voluntary. You may withdraw without penalty or loss of unrelated product access.
en.withdrawal: Use the pilot withdrawal control or contact privacy@lites.dev. New collection stops, the account is removed from future metric denominators according to the frozen rule, and pilot payloads are deleted with receipts while minimal consent and deletion audit facts remain.
en.contact: Questions, safety concerns and privacy requests: privacy@lites.dev.

zh-CN.title: Lites 设计伙伴试点知情同意书
zh-CN.purpose: 评估 Lites 是否能通过 Goal、Map、Learn、Practice、Create 和 Evidence，帮助用户把已有能力迁移到科技或 AI 职业方向。
zh-CN.procedures: 使用隔离的试点账号连续参与 28 天，完成冻结的入门、路线、每日闭环和有界项目任务，并可选择提供结构化反馈。
zh-CN.data: 我们收集去标识化的事件名称与时间、预定义任务结果、语言与迁移分层、量表分数、同意与退出事件以及技术可靠性事件。试点指标不收集对话正文、复盘正文、BYOK 值、密码、原始令牌或无关的雇主数据。
zh-CN.risks: 可能出现不便、挫折、AI 建议不准确，或用户意外输入个人信息。Lites 不用于招聘、晋升、解雇或排名决策。
zh-CN.benefits: 参与者可能获得结构化能力迁移路线，但不保证个人收益。
zh-CN.voluntary: 参与完全自愿，可随时退出，不受处罚，也不影响与试点无关的产品访问。
zh-CN.withdrawal: 使用试点退出功能或联系 privacy@lites.dev。系统停止新增采集，按冻结规则从后续指标分母移除该账号，并生成删除凭据；仅保留最小同意与删除审计事实。
zh-CN.contact: 问题、安全顾虑与隐私请求：privacy@lites.dev。

requiredAffirmations: I am at least 18 years old.
I read the study purpose, procedures, collected data, risks and withdrawal process in a language I understand.
I understand Lites is not an employment decision system and its AI output may be wrong.
I voluntarily consent to the frozen pilot data collection described above.
I know how to withdraw and request deletion.
